issues.quote: Operating income climbed to $81.5 billion in fiscal 2025 from $4.2 billion in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 operating income was about $33.0 billion; $4.2 billion is the fiscal 2023 figure. Real growth was about 147%, not about 19 times.

data.summary: Most figures are correct (revenue, gross profit and margin, fiscal 2025 operating income and margin, net income, EPS, R&D), but fiscal 2024 operating income is wrong: it was about $33.0 billion, not $4.2 billion (the fiscal 2023 figure).
